policies.name: Employees can view their own training assignments
Employees can update their own assignment progress
policies.with_check:
((employee_id = current_employee_id()) AND (id = COALESCE(current_setting('togetherly.verified_assignment_update_id'::text, true), ''::text)) AND (verification_status = ANY (ARRAY['not-started'::text, 'in-progress'::text, 'pending-verification'::text])) AND ((verification_status <> 'pending-verification'::text) OR ((submission_id IS NOT NULL) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM training_submissions s
  WHERE ((s.id = training_assignments.submission_id) AND (s.employee_id = current_employee_id()) AND (s.status = 'pending-verification'::text)))))))

policies.name: Reviewers and Admins can insert training assignments
policies.with_check: is_reviewer_or_admin()

policies.name: Reviewers and Admins can update other employees training assign
policies.with_check: (is_reviewer_or_admin() AND ((employee_id <> current_employee_id()) OR (current_system_role() = 'admin'::text)))

policies.name: Reviewers and Admins can delete training assignments
Submissions select policy
Employees can submit their own training completion claims
policies.with_check: ((employee_id = current_employee_id()) AND (status = 'pending-verification'::text) AND (reviewer_id IS NULL) AND (reviewer_name IS NULL) AND (review_timestamp IS NULL) AND (reviewer_notes IS NULL) AND (rejection_reason IS NULL))

policies.name: Employees can resubmit evidence on their own pending/rejected c
policies.with_check: ((employee_id = current_employee_id()) AND (status = 'pending-verification'::text) AND (reviewer_id IS NULL) AND (reviewer_name IS NULL) AND (review_timestamp IS NULL) AND (reviewer_notes IS NULL) AND (rejection_reason IS NULL))

policies.name: Reviewers can review and decide on training submissions
policies.with_check: (is_reviewer_or_admin() AND (employee_id <> current_employee_id()) AND (reviewer_id = current_employee_id()) AND (review_timestamp IS NOT NULL) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['verified'::text, 'rejected'::text, 'needs-more-evidence'::text])) AND ((status <> 'rejected'::text) OR ((rejection_reason IS NOT NULL) AND (length(btrim(rejection_reason)) > 0))) AND ((status <> 'needs-more-evidence'::text) OR ((reviewer_notes IS NOT NULL) AND (length(btrim(reviewer_notes)) > 0))))

policies.name: Audit logs are viewable by submitter or reviewers
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM training_submissions s
  WHERE ((s.id = verification_audit_logs.submission_id) AND ((s.employee_id = current_employee_id()) OR is_reviewer_or_admin()))))

policies.name: Authenticated users can record audit entries
policies.with_check:
((actor_id = current_employee_id()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM employees e
  WHERE ((e.id = current_employee_id()) AND (e.name = verification_audit_logs.actor_name) AND (((verification_audit_logs.action = ANY (ARRAY['submitted'::text, 'resubmitted'::text])) AND ((verification_audit_logs.actor_role = 'employee'::text) OR (verification_audit_logs.actor_role = e.system_role)) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM training_submissions s
          WHERE ((s.id = verification_audit_logs.submission_id) AND (s.employee_id = e.id))))) OR ((verification_audit_logs.action = ANY (ARRAY['approved'::text, 'rejected'::text, 'requested_more_evidence'::text])) AND (e.system_role = ANY (ARRAY['manager'::text, 'hr'::text, 'admin'::text])) AND ((verification_audit_logs.actor_role = e.system_role) OR (verification_audit_logs.actor_role = 'manager'::text)) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM training_submissions s
          WHERE ((s.id = verification_audit_logs.submission_id) AND (s.employee_id <> e.id))))))))))

policies.name: Evidence read policy
policies.using: ((bucket_id = 'training-evidence'::text) AND (((current_employee_id() IS NOT NULL) AND (storage_evidence_owner_id(name) = current_employee_id())) OR is_reviewer_or_admin()))

policies.name: Evidence insert policy
policies.with_check: ((bucket_id = 'training-evidence'::text) AND (current_employee_id() IS NOT NULL) AND (storage_evidence_owner_id(name) = current_employee_id()))

policies.name: Evidence update policy
policies.using:
((bucket_id = 'training-evidence'::text) AND (current_employee_id() IS NOT NULL) AND (storage_evidence_owner_id(name) = current_employee_id()) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM training_submissions s
  WHERE ((s.evidence_storage_path = objects.name) AND (s.status = 'verified'::text))))))
policies.with_check: ((bucket_id = 'training-evidence'::text) AND (current_employee_id() IS NOT NULL) AND (storage_evidence_owner_id(name) = current_employee_id()))

policies.name: Evidence delete policy
policies.using:
((bucket_id = 'training-evidence'::text) AND (((current_employee_id() IS NOT NULL) AND (storage_evidence_owner_id(name) = current_employee_id()) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM training_submissions s
  WHERE ((s.evidence_storage_path = objects.name) AND (s.status = 'verified'::text)))))) OR (current_system_role() = 'admin'::text)))

policies.name: Employees upload own profile evidence
policies.with_check: ((bucket_id = 'employee-profile-evidence'::text) AND (current_employee_id() IS NOT NULL) AND (split_part(name, '/'::text, 1) = current_employee_id()))

triggers.trigger_definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_registration_requests_security_guard BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.employee_registration_requests FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_registration_request_security_guard()
CREATE TRIGGER employees_role_requires_verified_claim BEFORE UPDATE OF role ON public.employees FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_verified_employee_job_title()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_employees_security_guard BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.employees FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_employees_security_guard()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_sync_employee_claims_to_auth_user AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.employees FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION sync_employee_claims_to_auth_user()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_sync_employee_to_registration_request AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.employees FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION sync_employee_to_registration_request()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_zz_prevent_rejected_employee_identity_link BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.employees FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION prevent_rejected_employee_identity_link()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_training_assignments_update_guard BEFORE UPDATE ON public.training_assignments FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_training_assignment_update_guard()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_training_submissions_integrity BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.training_submissions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_training_submission_integrity()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_verification_audit_logs_integrity BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.verification_audit_logs FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_verification_audit_log_integrity()
CREATE TRIGGER enforce_bucket_name_length_trigger BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF name ON storage.buckets FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION storage.enforce_bucket_name_length()
CREATE TRIGGER protect_bucket_control_insert BEFORE INSERT ON storage.buckets FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION storage.protect_bucket_control_columns('service_role')

CREATE TRIGGER protect_bucket_control_update BEFORE UPDATE OF lifecycle_configuration, lifecycle_configuration_generation ON storage.buckets FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION storage.protect_bucket_control_columns()

CREATE TRIGGER protect_bucket_control_update_role AFTER UPDATE OF lifecycle_configuration, lifecycle_configuration_generation ON storage.buckets FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION storage.enforce_bucket_lifecycle_service_role('service_role')
CREATE TRIGGER protect_buckets_delete BEFORE DELETE ON storage.buckets FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION storage.protect_delete()
CREATE TRIGGER protect_objects_delete BEFORE DELETE ON storage.objects FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION storage.protect_delete()
CREATE TRIGGER update_objects_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON storage.objects FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION storage.update_updated_at_column()

indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX activities_pkey ON public.activities USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX idx_activities_timestamp ON public.activities USING btree ("timestamp" DESC)
CREATE INDEX admin_access_audit_logs_created_at_idx ON public.admin_access_audit_logs USING btree (created_at DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX admin_access_audit_logs_pkey ON public.admin_access_audit_logs USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX admin_access_audit_logs_target_idx ON public.admin_access_audit_logs USING btree (target_employee_id, created_at DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX app_settings_pkey ON public.app_settings USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX employee_offboarding_audit_employee_idx ON public.employee_offboarding_audit USING btree (employee_id, removed_at DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX employee_offboarding_audit_pkey ON public.employee_offboarding_audit USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX employee_offboarding_audit_removed_at_idx ON public.employee_offboarding_audit USING btree (removed_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX employee_profile_claim_audit_claim_idx ON public.employee_profile_claim_audit USING btree (claim_id, created_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX employee_profile_claim_audit_pkey ON public.employee_profile_claim_audit USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX employee_profile_claims_employee_status_idx ON public.employee_profile_claims USING btree (employee_id, status, created_at DESC)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX employee_profile_claims_one_pending_job_title_per_employee ON public.employee_profile_claims USING btree (employee_id) WHERE ((claim_type = 'job-title'::text) AND (status = 'pending-verification'::text))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX employee_profile_claims_pkey ON public.employee_profile_claims USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX employee_profile_claims_status_created_idx ON public.employee_profile_claims USING btree (status, created_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX employee_profile_claims_submission_idx ON public.employee_profile_claims USING btree (submission_id, created_at) WHERE (submission_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX employee_profile_submissions_employee_submitted_idx ON public.employee_profile_submissions USING btree (employee_id, submitted_at DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX employee_profile_submissions_pkey ON public.employee_profile_submissions USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX employee_registration_requests_auth_user_id_key ON public.employee_registration_requests USING btree (auth_user_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX employee_registration_requests_pkey ON public.employee_registration_requests USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX idx_emp_reg_requests_created_at ON public.employee_registration_requests USING btree (created_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX idx_emp_reg_requests_dept ON public.employee_registration_requests USING btree (requested_department)
CREATE INDEX idx_emp_reg_requests_email ON public.employee_registration_requests USING btree (lower(email))
CREATE INDEX idx_emp_reg_requests_role ON public.employee_registration_requests USING btree (assigned_role)
CREATE INDEX idx_emp_reg_requests_status ON public.employee_registration_requests USING btree (status)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX employee_skills_employee_id_skill_id_key ON public.employee_skills USING btree (employee_id, skill_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX employee_skills_employee_skill_uidx ON public.employee_skills USING btree (employee_id, skill_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX employee_skills_pkey ON public.employee_skills USING btree (id)
